queries_run: Seagate STX top customer revenue concentration 10-K fiscal 2026
Seagate customer concentration risk disclosure cloud hyperscale customers percent of revenue
Seagate hyperscale cloud customers credit rating OR balance sheet stress 2026
Seagate customer bankruptcy OR downgrade OR guidance cut 2026 data center hard drive demand

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended 2026-07-03): one customer accounted for approximately 14% of Seagate's consolidated revenue. Two secondary sources (Stock Titan 10-K summary and GuruFocus SWOT) give the same figure.
findings.source: Stock Titan, 'Seagate outlines data storage strategy and risks | STX Annual Report (10-K)' https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/STX/10-k-seagate-technology-holdings-plc-files-annual-report-6e534d62e382.html ; GuruFocus, 'STX SWOT Analysis: Financial Strength and Market Challenges Revealed in 10-K Filing' https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9004434/stx-swot-analysis-financial-strength-and-market-challenges-revealed-in-10k-filing

findings.claim: Trefis reports Seagate management said nearline capacity is almost fully allocated through calendar 2027 (headline: 'Seagate Is Sold Out Through 2027 As AI Reshapes Hard Drive Demand'), following the Q3 FY2026 earnings call of 2026-04-28.
findings.source: Trefis, 'Seagate Is Sold Out Through 2027 As AI Reshapes Hard Drive Demand' https://www.trefis.com/stock/stx/articles/597921/seagate-is-sold-out-through-2027-as-ai-reshapes-hard-drive-demand/2026-04-30

note: Credit half of the question: no source found showing credit downgrade, bankruptcy, or guidance cut at Seagate's large customers in 2026 (search 4 returned only demand-strong results); this is absence of evidence, not a confirmed clean bill. Customer names were not found in any source retrieved, so customer-specific credit ratings were not searched by name. Unresolved conflict: one search snippet (note.com Japanese commentary on FY2026 10-K) said three customers at 18%/16%/10% (44% total); the two fetched pages (Stock Titan, GuruFocus) both say one customer ~14%. The 18/16/10 figure was not confirmed against the 10-K and is not recorded as a finding. Seagate's own credit/debt items (Fitch investment-grade upgrade, total debt $3.6B at FY2026 end) appeared in search snippets but were not verified with a dated primary source, so are not recorded here.
